meta.decision: tests/golden/wire_dict_baseline.json is preserved byte-unchanged. This layer is the expected change on the 19 DIP24_2816 records. It is applied LAST.
meta.cause: tools/build_db.py now emits the upstream write granularity as page_size for every DIP24_2816 row (1 on 17 rows, 16 on X2816B/C and XLE28C16B), and erase_support excludes the DIP24_2816 pin map, so FLAG_CAN_ERASE is clear on these rows. They have no command decoder: the software erase would store bytes as data.
meta.overlap: The 153 layer set flags=2 on these 19 records. This layer sets flags=0 on them again. That is the one intended field overlap between two layers, and the test applies this layer after all others.
meta.how_to_update: Change this file only together with the generator or erase_support change that moves these values, and name the chips in the commit message.
